breaking_news.headline: Trump to impose double-digit tariffs on dozens of countries

breaking_news.headline: Justice Dept. drops 'New York Times' subpoenas under pressure from judge
breaking_news.summary: The Justice Department is dropping the subpoenas it filed demanding grand jury testimony and phone records from New York Times journalists after sharp questioning Thursday from a federal judge.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. allies hit with new tariffs object to Trump's forced labor allegations
breaking_news.summary: Australia and the European Union were among U.S. trade partners who criticized the tariffs.

breaking_news.headline: Paramount says it will pause its Warner acquisition while legal challenges play out
breaking_news.summary: A dozen states and the Writers Guild of America had challenged the merger.

breaking_news.headline: Trump is hellbent on tariffs. Here are 5 implications

breaking_news.headline: President Trump just implemented new tariffs. How are small businesses coping?
breaking_news.summary: An NPR business correspondent explains how to cover the complex story of how small businesses are coping with tariffs.

breaking_news.headline: Rage-giving, innovation and cuts: How public media has survived without federal funds
breaking_news.summary: A year after President Trump signed a law ending six decades of federal funding of public media, it's a time of reinvention, innovation and clear anxiety at public tv and radio stations nationwide.

breaking_news.headline: Oil prices are climbing again. Here's why this time could be different

breaking_news.headline: Iran-backed Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia

breaking_news.headline: Zelensky tries to fix crisis over removal of defence minister and counts the cost

breaking_news.headline: India's 'cockroach' protest called off after education minister quits

breaking_news.headline: Trump takes swipes at press during White House Correspondents' Dinner
breaking_news.summary: The event celebrated press freedom after the first dinner was cancelled by a shooting in April.

breaking_news.headline: Firefighters battle wildfire as tens of thousands evacuated near Bordeaux

breaking_news.headline: Israeli settlers set fire to mosques, cars and farm land in West Bank, Palestinians say

breaking_news.headline: What we know so far about the Berlin Pride ramming attack

breaking_news.headline: Faisal Islam: The UK's Trump trade deal no longer looks world-beating

breaking_news.headline: Paramount and Warner Bros pause $110bn merger amid legal challenge
